reviews.title: Great price, performance more than adequate.
reviews.comment: Great price to performance ratio.  High speed, no reliability problems after 4 months.  Not the highest performance drive on the market, but when using an SSD I kind of wonder if you really can notice any meaningful difference.  I went from a Samsung Pro 1TB model to this one, and the only thing I really notice is the huge capacity increase.

reviews.title: good drives for the cost
reviews.comment: i like TeamGroup. Good ol' MP44. I think i have about 24 or 25 of these drives i've bought over the last couple of years. no joke. i put these things in everything. i have 9 of them in my primary desktop alone (4 in an external SSD array and 5 sitting in the motherboard). They are running in Hard Raid mode. They are not the fastest but also not the slowest either. The price point is great for the quality you get. i've not had one of these drives fail yet. I also have 2 Raspberry Pi 5's each of them have 2 of these drives attached. These drives are my go to drives for pretty much everything. when 4TB SSDs come down in price i'll start buying those. but for now, 2TB is just fine.
